program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = u - g * t; const height = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const acceleration = -g; const force = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t < apexTime - 0.05) { motionState = "Rising"; } else if (t <= apexTime + 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (height > 0) { motionState = "Falling"; } else { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } const points = []; const stepCount = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= stepCount; i++) { const st = (i / stepCount) * (2 * apexTime); const sv = u - g * st; points.push({ x: st, y: sv }); } const ballY = 220 - height * 80; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 360, title: "Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 30, w: 300, h: 360, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 50, y: 350, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 160, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); const vecV = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 160, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" }); objects.push(...vecV); const vecA = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 130, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" }); objects.push(...vecA); const callout = sdk.callout(190, ballY - 30, [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(1)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" }); objects.push(...callout); const plotObj = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 340, y: 70, w: 260, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points }] }); objects.push(plotObj); const readouts = [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }]; const quantities = { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force }; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts }, quantities }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration remains -g and gravitational force is mg, showing that mass changes the force but not the motion.
manifest.description: Two panels show a vertical toss on the left with velocity and acceleration vectors, and a velocity-time graph on the right.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
